dedupe_keys.name: bank danych o lasach forest data bank poland forest inventory reports and maps including fire access roads

description: The Bank Danych o Lasach (BDL, Forest Data Bank) is Poland's public database of forest information gathered by foresters, published online since 2013 and funded from the forest fund of the State Forests (Lasy Państwowe), with the Forest Management and Geodesy Bureau (BULiGL) preparing its updates. It covers all forests in the country, both those managed by the State Forests and those outside them, with a 2024 update for forests outside the State Forests. A report generator produces predefined and custom tables of forest area, stands and species, exportable as PDF or XLS, and the map service shows forest division boundaries, fire access roads (mapa dojazdów pożarowych), tourist infrastructure, entry bans and private forests; a desktop Mapa PU application is offered for forest management plans. Coverage is national; resolution runs down to the forest division and stand. Format and access: web reports (PDF, XLS), web maps and metadata pages. Licence: the portal rules say access is general and free of charge and that data are shared under the 2008 act on access to environmental information; reusers must name the source and date. Free. Caveats: map views are illustrative and not official documents, and spatial data downloads are free only for public administration bodies. Simulation uses: wildfire exposure of roads, power lines and settlements next to forests, fire service access planning and vegetation inputs for hazard models. Related records: no directly related records are catalogued yet.
